description: Allowlist a redirect URL on an instance for SSO in a mobile or desktop application. Supports HTTPS URLs and custom schemes such as my-app://oauth-callback. Returns the created redirect URL object. An already allowlisted URL returns an error.

instance.description: Instance to target: "development", "production", or a full instance ID (ins_…).

url.description: Redirect URL to allowlist, such as my-app://oauth-callback.

name: create_redirect_url
title: Create redirect URL
